description: Offres de services bus tram et scolaire (au format GTFS & Netex & GTFS-RT & SIRI-Lite) is a dataset listed in DataHub Métropole de Bordeaux open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Bordeaux Métropole. Ce jeu de donnée renseigne l'offre de transport théorique (lignes, arrêts, horaires) du réseau TBM, ainsi que les données temps réel. L'offre de service tram, bus et bus scolaire est téléchargeable au format GTFS et Netex (la documentation Netex associée est en pièce jointe de ce jeu). Coverage: Bordeaux Métropole. The portal files it under Transports/mobilité. Its keywords are bus, tram, gtfs, data-gouv, siri-lite. The portal shows 11 records. The portal shows 2025-06-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-datahub-bordeaux-metropole-fr-portal.
